name: Constrict
body:
You can use your serpentine lower body to crush foes that you grapple.

Prerequisite(s): Legless species trait, venomborn.

Benefit(s): You can grapple foes with your lower body, leaving your hands free. When you do so, you also inflict bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 plus 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier, as per the construct universal monster ability.
